title: Keep an acoustic-limit warning and the literal correction-class failure
statement: The ongoing parent reports eliminating the background matrix by a Schur complement, while warning that the pseudoinverse AT an acoustic zero omits constraints surviving in the limit. A separate full-column polynomial cubic heat-jet calculation reports no nonzero compatible cubic, with primitive-jet rank16,joint rank36 and cubic obstruction rank20. Since that failure includes translated energies already known QC, it excludes this polynomial correction form rather than positivity or quasiconvexity. Initial three-wave numerical searches found no separation candidates; angular correction remains a separate investigation.
